author: lbqaq
quote: GTA 6 looks insane, sure, but shiny graphics and realistic animations don’t magically make a game fun. GTA has been recycling the same basic gameplay for years: drive here, shoot these guys, follow the mission script, repeat. The world may be huge, but the actual choices are paper-thin, and there’s barely any strategy or skill to learn. All that realism is cool for a while, but if the gameplay is still this shallow, it’s just the same old GTA with a fresh coat of paint.
